scope: TZ-aware bounds correctness for production MySQL (TIMESTAMP UTC vs Paris-local fixture)
Index coverage for KDS sync delta query

production_tz_invariants.mysql_session_tz: UTC (no `timezone` key in config/database.php mysql connection)
production_tz_invariants.orders_order_datetime_column_type: TIMESTAMP — internally stored as UTC unix-seconds, MySQL converts at read/write per session TZ
production_tz_invariants.orders_updated_at_column_type: TIMESTAMP — same UTC storage as order_datetime
production_tz_invariants.consequence: Binding Carbon::today() raw -> 'Y-m-d 00:00:00' Paris-local string. MySQL sees that as UTC literal -> queries shift by 1-2h (DST-dependent)

heal_pattern_attestation.pattern: Carbon::today($appTz)->setTimezone('UTC') for day-start bounds + Carbon::today($appTz)->endOfDay()->setTimezone('UTC') for day-end + Carbon::tomorrow($appTz)->setTimezone('UTC') for advance-order upper bound
correctness_proof: Paris-local 'today midnight' = 22:00 UTC (CEST summer) or 23:00 UTC (CET winter)
setTimezone('UTC') correctly converts the Carbon Paris instance to UTC string for binding
MySQL TIMESTAMP comparison against UTC literal matches UTC storage byte-for-byte
whereBetween + < tomorrow remain sargable on idx_orders_datetime

findings.claim: TZ-aware bounds are CORRECT for production MySQL with UTC session TZ and TIMESTAMP columns.
evidence: MySQL TIMESTAMP semantics: stored UTC, presented in session_tz on read. Session_tz=UTC -> bind matches storage directly.
Heal pattern uses ->setTimezone('UTC') which converts the Carbon to UTC before Eloquent .toDateTimeString() at bind
Verified against KdsSyncTzAwareTest.php (191 lines, 8 tests in Wave 2c) + SisterServicesTzAwareTest.php (362 lines, Wave 2b) + SisterServicesTzAwareV2Test.php (485 lines, Wave 3c)

findings.claim: Sargability preserved — idx_orders_datetime is used by the converted query.
evidence: Wave 1 KDS Architect P1 heal: whereDate -> whereBetween + '<' tomorrow (KdsSyncService.php:60-64 comment)
Sentinel: tests/Feature/KDS/KdsSyncSargableTest.php asserts EXPLAIN plan uses the index
10x-30x performance regression averted at 50+ open orders/branch admin polling

findings.claim: DST-switch days produce shorter/longer queries which is correct.
evidence: 2026-03-29 (spring forward in Paris): Carbon::today('Europe/Paris') = 2026-03-29 00:00 Paris -> 2026-03-28 23:00 UTC. endOfDay -> 2026-03-29 21:59:59 UTC. 23h window matches reality of shorter day. No orders skipped (Paris day genuinely has 23h on that date).
2026-10-25 (fall back): symmetric 25h window matches reality of longer day.
whereBetween includes any TIMESTAMP in that range — correct behavior, not a bug

findings.claim: deleted_ids query path (KdsSyncService.php:120-138) does NOT need TZ conversion — only filters on updated_at >= sinceForDb which is itself a UTC TIMESTAMP from server_now.
evidence: KdsSyncService.php:36 — DateTimeImmutable $since param comes from client lastSync stamp which itself was server_now (ISO 8601 UTC)
$sinceForDb = $since->format('Y-m-d H:i:s') — already UTC since param is in UTC
No Carbon::today/now usage in the deleted_ids branch
No risk of TZ drift here

findings.claim: 10 KDS test failures (documented V1.0.X) are FIXTURE-side, NOT prod-side — the heal pattern is correct.
evidence: SQLite test driver evaluates Carbon::today() literally in PHP, then binds the string — no MySQL TIMESTAMP TZ conversion semantics
Test fixtures created with 'evening Paris' timestamps fall outside the [Paris-day-start-UTC, Paris-day-end-UTC] window when test clock straddles midnight UTC
Owner mandate: V1.0.X for session-A. Production behavior is CORRECT (this audit confirms)
Failing tests known: SisterServicesTzAwareTest (subset), KdsSyncTzAwareTest (subset). Documented in PROJECT_BRAIN + commit 9df4809b5 (docs)
findings.recommendation: DO NOT heal here. Owner mandate explicit. V1.0.X for session-A.

verdict: TZ-aware bounds are PRODUCTION-CORRECT for MySQL UTC session + Paris app TZ + TIMESTAMP columns. Sargability preserved. Sister-service heals attested intact. DST behavior correct (shorter/longer day windows match reality). 10 KDS test failures known + documented + scoped to V1.0.X per owner mandate.
